alert: An inline message on the card fill, with an optional icon. Destructive turns the text red.
avatar: A round image with an initials fallback.
badge: A small label. Default, secondary, outline, destructive, and the rare peach chip.
breadcrumb: The trail above a page title, in meta type.
button: One 32px height for every action. Primary, outline, ghost and solid-red destructive, plus 28px and 24px icon sizes.
card: shadcn's card: white on the tinted page in light, the nested fill in dark, one radius.
checkbox: A 16px box with a firm edge, filled with ink when ticked.
dialog: A centred modal with 20px padding, no close cross (every dialog ends in Cancel), scaling in from 97%.
dropdown-menu: A menu on the popover surface, with its own hover step.
empty: The parts of an empty state: media, title, description, content.
input: A text field: white with an input edge in light, filled with no stroke in dark, and a coral edge on focus.
popover: A floating panel on the popover surface. Fields inside take the lifted fill.
radio-group: Radios whose checked dot is a thick ring.
select: A 32px select whose list sits on the popover surface.
sheet: A panel that slides in from an edge.
skeleton: A pulsing placeholder on the hover step.
slider: A thin track with an ink range and thumb.
sonner: Sonner's toaster on Bricks' toast tokens and Phosphor icons. Needs next-themes, or pass theme yourself.
switch: A 32 × 18 switch: ink when on, the page surface with a grey thumb when off.
toggle: The item a segmented control is made of.
toggle-group: The one segmented control: a 32px track, 24px thumbs, 4px of air.
tooltip: A small ink label with an arrow.
data-rows: Lists and tables as one bordered row group: 48px rows, column headers outside, one flexing column, hover actions, a coral ring on the selected row.
detail-panel: The 320px details panel on the right: a Sentient title and icon actions on top, overlaying the content below lg.
info-blocks: Spacing for any stack of details: 20px padding, 24px between groups, property rows, a pinned footer.
page-header: Breadcrumb, display-face title, byline and controls, with a 32px search field.
state-message: Empty, error and locked states: centred, a Sentient title, one line, at most one action.
